text: Wasted time on tutorial only to find out there is a forced login/sign up later (!!!). I wish I could give negative stars for something like this... Edit. Answer for ur reply: BIG NO, backing data or sync should be only a choice and habit's apps first of all should work offline too. Take a look for fine habit's apps like do it now (with gamify) or habitnow, there no one forces user to sign up. Anyway, ur app, do what u want, I won't wish u success with this approach
author: Daniel S.
developer_reply: Hi Daniel, the login requirement is essential for backing up your data and making sure the app works properly. We don't ask for any payment or credit card — just a simple account to save your data, nothing else. Sorry if the time spent on the tutorial felt like a big inconvenience. Wishing you a great day! 🍀
